Frequently asked questions

What information is required to apply for a Venture X Business card?

To apply for the Venture X Business card, you must be an authorized representative for your business. You’ll need to provide personal and business details to verify your identity and establish creditworthiness. Your application may be declined if you have a freeze with credit bureaus.

Personal information includes:

  • Full legal name

  • Personal contact information

  • Social Security number

  • Monthly rent or mortgage payment

Business information includes:

  • Tax ID or Employer ID Number (EIN), or an SSN for sole proprietorships

  • Annual revenue 

  • Monthly business spend

  • Names and information of other beneficial owners or controllers

How much is the Venture X Business annual fee?

The Venture X Business card has a $395 annual fee and offers travel benefits, access to Capital One Business Travel, expense management and accounts payable solutions.

You’ll also receive:

  • An annual $300 credit when you book through Capital One Business Travel

  • 10,000 bonus miles ($100 value) on your anniversary

  • Up to a $120 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit when you use your Venture X Business card to apply

  • Access to Priority Pass and Capital One Lounge and Landing access 

  • A early spend bonus when you spend a certain amount within the first few months of opening your card

How does a card with no preset spending limit work?

No preset spending limit cards, like Venture X Business, don’t have a fixed line like a traditional credit card. Instead, your purchasing power adjusts dynamically based on your spending and payment behaviors. This means that your limit is flexible, not unlimited. These cards are designed to be paid in full, which is one factor that determines how much you’re able to spend on the card at a time.

Does my Venture X Business card come with lounge access or Priority Pass?

As a primary Venture X Business cardholder, you’ll enjoy complimentary access to Capital One’s growing network of premium Lounges and Landings. Your membership also includes Priority Pass enrollment, granting you entry to more than 1,300 lounges around the world.
